title: Persist six Principal personal objectives as a level distinct from the LVT

title: Ratify holistic domain-first API design as PRIN-ARCH-HOLISTIC-DOMAIN-API
context: 4AM v2 API design review.
evidence_at_time: Review shifted from endpoint/bug focus to domain-model/URI topology.
principal_wording: this is a decent step in the right direction. we're thinking holistically about the domain model, not myopically about some feature we're trying to implement in the moment. this is another principle that we need to persist. this the the right way to think about api design.
rationale: A locally convenient endpoint must not become the organizing assumption for the public API.
expected_consequences: URI-topology critique precedes code/contract inspection when adding or expanding API resources; no wholesale v2 replacement or delivery pause implied.
